title: Personal Loans Servicing Standard: Returned Payments and the Returned-Payment Fee
content:
## Standard in force

When a posted payment on a Personal Loans loan comes back unpaid, the return reverses that payment exactly: its interest portion is restored to accrued interest (the interest paid-through date returns to its value before the payment), its principal portion is re-added to principal, every fee payment line it funded is reversed so those fees are unpaid again, and any installment it had covered is unpaid again (the next due date moves back). A return is recorded against the one payment it reverses, never against the loan in general.

A returned-payment fee is charged once for each returned payment whose return code is R01, R02, R03, R04, R08, R09, R16 or R20. No returned-payment fee is charged for returns coded R07, R10 or R29 or for a debit card chargeback (CB); those are authorization disputes handled by the payments team. At most one returned-payment fee is charged per returned payment, and no more than 2 returned-payment fees (the grade's monthly maximum) are charged on a loan in one calendar month.

A returned payment can also leave an installment unpaid past its grace period, in which case the late fee terms apply separately; the two fees are independent. Larkspur does not re-present a returned payment automatically. If the returned payment had paid the loan off, the loan is reinstated to active with its closing date and closure reason cleared. Returned AutoPay debits count toward automatic AutoPay cancellation under the AutoPay terms.

## Clause no longer in force for the latest return

The clause below is no longer in force for the returned-payment fee owed on the latest returned payment on the loan (on a tie of dates, the first one recorded), whose amount is worked out under the current returned-payment fee figuring. Every other returned-payment fee, one owed on an earlier fee-bearing return included, remains under it:

> The fee amount follows the loan's state fee schedule (the state fee schedule map of the late fee terms): the schedule A, schedule B or schedule C returned-payment fee; under schedule C the fee is 0.00 and no fee line is written.

## Return codes

| Return code | Returned-payment fee |
|---|---|
| R01, R02, R03, R04, R08, R09, R16, R20 | charged, one per returned payment |
| R07, R10, R29, debit card chargeback (CB) | not charged |

## Monthly limit (hypothetical month)

Three fee-bearing returns in one calendar month on one loan: the first two can each carry a returned-payment fee; the third carries none that month.
